description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.10 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Rem] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Rem
description.text: Increases [Holy Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Rem after using three Holy abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Siphon Sphere+
description.text: Six single attacks (3.87/4.02 each) after 0-2/3+ uses, Smart ether 1 on every second activation

description.name: Spirit Attack: Rem
description.text: Five single attacks (1.60 each) and grants [Holy Ability +30% Boost 3] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
